name: low_vol_exactly_at_min_history
description: Exactly MC_MIN_HISTORY_DAYS (20) days of alternating SPY and AAA returns. At exactly 20 days the function does NOT short-circuit at the sufficiency guard. NOTE (Cluster 2 AC-4): after the early-window exclusion drops the first MC_VOL_WINDOW_DAYS-1 = 19 days, a 20-day history leaves a single eligible kNN candidate — a degenerate 1-neighbour pool whose bootstrap CDF snaps prob_beating to {0.0, 100.0}. This fixture is live evidence of the degenerate-pool boundary that the AC-4 eligible-pool-size policy question concerns; it pins the current GREEN behaviour pending that ruling.
derivation: Re-captured from the fixed producer at branch fix/mc-knn-exit-gate HEAD 7ff61a4 (Cluster 2) with run_monte_carlo(..., seed=42). The value shifted from the pre-Cluster-2 50.74 because AC-4 excludes the first MC_VOL_WINDOW_DAYS-1 = 19 early-window days: a 20-day history leaves exactly ONE eligible candidate, the kNN bootstraps from a single day, and the resulting one-point CDF places current_symphony_return strictly above it -> prob_beating = 0.0 (a deterministic boundary value of the degenerate 1-neighbour pool, not a random draw). Provenance: captured-from-the-fixed-producer; flagged as degenerate-pool evidence for the AC-4 policy ruling.
